synth.notes:
Mirror-axis game: render per 3x3-block sprite stacks (piece>reflection>target>wall), then re-extract by colour; A1-A4 move the selected axis/piece, A5 cycles axis->pieces largest first.
Missed mechanic at step 64: budget counter. The first 64 actions are free, then each non-A7 action shrinks the HUD bar (h=min(64,128-n), y=64-h). n is hidden and counted under the continuity gate.
Once the bar has shrunk, the spent segment counts as one extra component ranked before the pieces (piece_i -> piece_{i+1}). Walls are not renamed.
A7 = undo the last position change of the axis/pieces. It keeps the current selection and does not use budget.
Unconfirmed: what colour/position the spent HUD cells are drawn in, and whether the counter resets on a level reset. Stateless fallback scores 102/104 (fails step 64 and the undo).
